select se.id as id, concat( coalesce(nullif(trim(s.series_name), ''), '赛事'), ' · ', coalesce(nullif(trim(se.display_title), ''), se.season_name) ) as label, ( select group_concat(distinct d.division_name order by d.sort_order, d.id separator ' / ') from basket_division d where d.season_id = se.id and d.is_delete = 0 ) as secondaryLabel, se.season_status as status from basket_season se left join basket_series s on s.id = se.series_id and s.is_delete = 0 where se.is_delete = 0
and ( se.season_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or se.display_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.series_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or exists ( select 1 from basket_division d where d.season_id = se.id and d.is_delete = 0 and ( d.division_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or d.platform_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or d.game_mode like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) )
order by se.id desc

select p.id as id, concat( coalesce(nullif(trim(p.player_no), ''), concat('球员#', p.id)), ' · ', coalesce(nullif(trim(ep.player_name_snapshot), ''), nullif(trim(p.game_nickname), ''), nullif(trim(mp.nickname), ''), '-') ) as label, concat( coalesce(nullif(trim(ep.game_id_snapshot), ''), nullif(trim(pa.display_game_id), ''), '-'), ' · ', coalesce(nullif(trim(et.team_name_snapshot), ''), nullif(trim(t.team_name), ''), '未关联球队'), ' · ', coalesce(nullif(trim(d.division_name), ''), '未分赛区'), ' · ', coalesce(nullif(trim(d.platform_code), ''), '-'), '/',
) as secondaryLabel, ep.event_player_status as status, p.member_id as memberId, coalesce(et.source_team_id, t.id) as teamId, ep.event_team_id as eventTeamId, ep.id as eventPlayerId, coalesce(nullif(trim(et.team_name_snapshot), ''), nullif(trim(t.team_name), '')) as teamName, p.player_no as playerNo, coalesce(nullif(trim(ep.game_id_snapshot), ''), nullif(trim(pa.display_game_id), '')) as gameId, d.division_name as divisionName, d.platform_code as platformCode, d.game_mode as gameMode from basket_event_player ep inner join basket_player_profile p on p.id = ep.source_player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = p.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_account acc on acc.id = p.member_id and acc.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_team et on et.id = ep.event_team_id and et.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team t on t.id = coalesce(et.source_team_id, p.current_team_id) and t.is_delete = 0 left join basket_division d on d.id = ep.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_platform_account pa on pa.player_id = p.id and pa.is_delete = 0 and pa.is_primary = 1 where ep.is_delete = 0 and ep.season_id = #{seasonId} and ep.source_player_id is not null
and ( p.player_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.game_nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.game_account like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or mp.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or acc.email like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ep.player_name_snapshot like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ep.game_id_snapshot like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or pa.display_game_id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or et.team_name_snapshot like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or d.division_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or d.platform_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by d.sort_order asc, d.id asc, p.player_no asc, ep.id asc
